mapper.select: SELECT lc.card_code AS cardId, lc.user_id AS userId, c.card_num AS cardNum, c.expiry_date AS expiryDate, lc.represent_yn AS representYn, COALESCE(c.card_name, '연결 카드') AS cardName, COALESCE(u.user_name, '회원') AS holderName FROM linked_card_tbl lc LEFT JOIN user_tbl u ON lc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY lc.represent_yn DESC, lc.card_code ASC
